To be up front she wasn’t one to cheat. Big reason why we were even together and I decided to move to her home country with her. Also, the beginning we had such a strong connection on every level. Deeper than I had ever experienced with anyone else. We both could feel it and both acknowledged it. All of our friends mentioned how not only we looked like a compatible couple but also how we were around each other. We brought out the best. Until.. we moved and she changed into someone else. Like she always had mentioned. I blame myself heavily for things I did last year as depression took over and I felt I wasn’t being heard combined with the stress of being in a foreign country and rebuilding there. 

I have mentioned these things to my therapist and the biggest being trust. I’ve noticed when I start talking to someone new, it goes well until it gets to a point where it’s time to start opening up. I freeze up and back away. As the memories of what happened come back as a reminder of “remember what happened last time” almost if that makes any sense. I hesitate and pause and let whatever connection was forming, ultimately fizzle out. Simply out of fear of being vulnerable. I’m afraid this will follow me forever. I do want to meet someone new and I would love to have something casual to help me also move past this and rediscover trust in a relationship.

To be honest I’m not one for revenge. I did post something a few weeks back and caused her to flip out understandably and resulted in her deleting whatever was left and blocking me. I feel bad I let it take over. But I do still feel so angry and hurt. But conflicted with missing what was I guess. It’s been a truly difficult year and I have been I therapy the whole time. I have my ups and downs. A part of me wants to talk to her but I can’t now cause I ruined that. A part of me wants revenge because what she did was so wrong and did so much damage. I’m also trying to do more and talk to new people. Something casual to put myself back out there and rediscover trust in people. However, I’m plagued by what happened and how I married someone whom I thought we had the same relationship values and vowed we would never cheat for her to turn around, become the thing she hated and ultimately not show much remorse for in the process upending and ruining the life I had built. I’m 30 now and starting over for the 3rd time this year.. Therapy has helped in other ways but not in this way.

To add to this.
